item.text: {"iteration":1,"pcvs":[{"name":"prefix_blocks","expression":"len(request.block_hashes)","rationale":"Bounds the number of full blocks examined during prefix-cache lookup."},{"name":"sequence_blocks","expression":"(request.num_tokens + self.block_size - 1) // self.block_size","rationale":"Tracks block allocation and block-table processing work."},{"name":"waiting_queue_size","expression":"len(request_queue)","rationale":"Captures variation in priority-queue removal work."},{"name":"cached_blocks","expression":"len(self.kv_cache_manager.block_pool.cached_block_hash_to_block)","rationale":"Provides cheap cache-state information distinguishing cold and populated prefix caches."}],"hypothesis":"Instruction count varies mainly with prefix lookup length, sequence block count, cache state, and priority-queue removal cost."}
